body.statement: For every \((i,t)\in G\times W\), in the fixed ordered local space \(\mathbb R^{I_{it}\times J_{it}}\), every native local optimizer satisfies the exact identity \(\widetilde M^{it}=\operatorname{SVT}_{\lambda}(P_{\Omega_{\mathrm{loc}}^{it}}R_{it}Y^{\mathrm{obs}}+P_{(\Omega_{\mathrm{loc}}^{it})^c}\widetilde M^{it})\). This identity holds for the implemented masked convex solution, not only for an auxiliary least-squares fit.
body.justification: The fixed-point identity is the entry point for differentiating the actual estimator under neighborhood replacement.
body.gap: Choi, Kwon, and Liao analyze an auxiliary-to-native bridge, but not this serial masked fixed point at second order.
body.consumer: The native second-order transfer theorem uses the identity to keep every perturbation tied to the optimizer implemented in the Tick Size reanalysis.
